name: design-studio-team-setup
description: Sets up a "company brain + desks" pattern for a new design consultancy client engagement: one shared Project Brain, a roster of role desks each with a one-page brief and a three-zone memory log, a shared research repository, a standing Digest Index rolling up every desk's current state, a retrieval mode for specific questions, a Delivery Manager that both reacts to status checks and proactively routes new multi-desk work, a visual desk-status dashboard, and a send/edit/skip review gate.
